import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
public class Main{
	static int MOD=998244353;
	static long powMod(long base, long exp) {
		long res=1;
		base%=MOD;
		while(exp>0){
			if((exp&1)==1) res=(res*base)%MOD;
			base=(base*base)%MOD;
			exp>>=1;
		}
		return res;
	}
	static long invMod(long x) {
		return powMod(x, MOD-2);
	}
	public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception{
		Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
		PrintWriter pw=new PrintWriter(System.out);
		long n=sc.nextLong(), m=sc.nextLong(), l=sc.nextLong(), r=sc.nextLong();
		if(l==r) {
			pw.println(1);
			pw.flush();
			return;
		}
		long oddCount=((r+1)/2)-(l/2);
		long evenCount=(r/2)-((l-1)/2);
		long totalCells=n*m;
		long ans;
		if((totalCells&1)==1) {
			ans=powMod(oddCount+evenCount, totalCells);

		}
		pw.println(ans);
		pw.flush();
	}
